memoryBuilder.verseText: Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

sequence.prompt: What happened when Jesus was baptized? Put it in order.

items.label: John baptizes people at the river

matches.prompt: Match each to what they did or mean.

pairs.right: The Holy Spirit coming on Jesus
Said: This is My beloved Son

application.question: God said Jesus is His beloved Son — and you are God's beloved child! How does it feel to know God loves you that much?
application.followUp: The words God spoke over Jesus — 'beloved,' 'well-pleasing' — God says the same over you because you belong to Him through Jesus.
